name: 海藻酸盐
title: 海藻酸盐
description: A family of alginic-acid and alginate additives used for gelling, thickening, stabilising and related texture functions. The EU family spans E400–E405, including propylene glycol alginate at E405.
what_is: A family of alginic-acid and alginate additives used for gelling, thickening, stabilising and related texture functions. The EU family spans E400–E405, including propylene glycol alginate at E405.
why_botia: BOTIA groups these terms because labels may use the individual alginate name or E-number. Their technological functions and legal maximum levels depend on the specific additive and food category.
can_1: Detect E400–E405 and the corresponding alginic-acid/alginate names.
can_2: Show the texture and E-number context for the declared family member.
cannot_1: Determine the concentration or exact technological function in the product from the name alone.
cannot_2: Assume that all alginates are used at the same level or for the same function.

sources.label: Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 — Union list and conditions of use for food additives
Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 — specifications for authorised food additives

aliases: E400, E401, E402, E403, E404, E405, alginic acid, sodium alginate, potassium alginate, ammonium alginate, calcium alginate, propane-1,2-diol alginate, propylene glycol alginate, hydroxypropyl alginate
